title: Grandma Kills 67-Year-Old Outside Community Center
description:
Miami Gardens police respond to a hit and run at a community center where 62-year-old Sharon Cox allegedly struck three pedestrians, killing 67-year-old Patricia Garner. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
